responsibility: Implements the standalone host-side launcher used to execute a compiled GCN kernel image through the HSA runtime. It dynamically loads HSA entry points, discovers a device and memory regions, loads the code object, locates kernel symbols, allocates and fills kernarg/heap/stack structures expected by the GCC GCN runtime ABI, dispatches init/main/fini kernels through an HSA queue, streams device printf-style output, and converts the device return/exit conventions into a host process exit status.
